claims.statement: Under the declared engineering envelopes for the complete sampling-and-preparation attempt, at least seven of ten finite attempts produce PreparedItem values with probability at least 0.75.
assumptions: Each sampling and preparation stage has bad-event probability at most 0.05, giving a complete-attempt envelope of at most 0.1 by the union bound.
The bound uses Markov's inequality over the number of bad outcomes and does not assume independent attempts.

claims.statement: All ten finite attempt prefixes reach typed outcomes within 25 ms under the declared sampling and preparation worker bounds.
assumptions: The production controller can dispatch the first ten attempts unless seven qualifying outcomes stop the prefix earlier.
Each sampling invocation reaches a typed outcome within two milliseconds and each preparation invocation within five milliseconds.
